01About

Part founder, part product owner, part builder.

I’m a mathematician, serial entrepreneur and technology innovator. In the early 2000s, I helped bring premium-rate interactive television quiz shows to more than 200 channels in nearly 70 countries, establishing over 40 studios across Europe, the Middle East and Asia.

After a stroke in 2009, I left the media industry and turned to early-stage businesses and technology ventures. I launched Indulj.Be and Mobile Weekend in 2011, worked with startups including Grofie and Leonar3Do, then focused on big data, recommendation systems and machine learning. From 2016 to 2020, I led Ringier Axel Springer’s Abimato Laboratory and an MVP Factory operating across 21 European countries.

During the COVID-19 lockdowns, I founded amanoba, supporting the move to digital education across more than 700 institutions in three countries. Since 2022, my work has focused on locally deployed AI and business applications, with an emphasis on privacy, security and technological independence. I continue building products and supporting founders through Moldován Csaba Kft.

02The Method

Eight D's, from idea to impact.

Every engagement runs through one repeatable framework — so nothing falls through the cracks between strategy and shipping.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand the problem, users and market. Validate the real need before a line of code.

  2. 02

    Discuss

    Align stakeholders on goals, constraints and success metrics.

  3. 03

    Define

    Turn intent into a sharp scope, roadmap and prioritised backlog.

  4. 04

    Design

    Shape the experience — flows, interface and architecture.

  5. 05

    Develop

    Build in tight iterations with working software every step.

  6. 06

    Deliver

    Ship to production, instrument it, and get it into real hands.

  7. 07

    Data

    Measure behaviour and outcomes — let evidence steer decisions.

  8. 08

    Drive

    Iterate, grow and pivot. Keep momentum until it compounds.

07The Company

Moldován Csaba Kft

A Budapest-based product studio and venture vehicle. We partner with founders and teams to design, build and ship software products — and we invest our own time and craft into a growing portfolio of platforms.

Whether you need a fractional product leader to steady a roadmap, a hands-on builder to take a concept to launch, or a partner to help you pivot — the goal is the same: make your product done.
